description: Move a feedback item to another status on the project board. Statuses are the project's own board columns — list_feedback returns them under "workflow.statuses", and clients can rename columns or add custom ones (e.g. "Design Review"), so always use a name from that list. Built-in names like "In Progress" also work. For resolving prefer resolve_feedback (or verify_feedback on a website), and for dismissing use wont_fix_feedback: that also records why in the thread.

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

status.description: Target status: a column name from list_feedback's workflow.statuses

name: set_feedback_status
title: Set the status of a feedback item
